what_happened: In job hvzg, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The reading again went wider than the one stage the request is about. The user told it to keep the narrowed scope from the last attempt (job 4zcq): producer stage only. A producer that hits its deadline keeps its worktree edits and a progress note. The job is recorded as timed out. `athena retry` resumes from the kept work. Status shows timed out apart from failed. No planning or verifier-stage changes.
cause: The user's earlier scope correction on this request family was not carried into the next attempt. The new reading is built from the request text alone. Athena does not see the earlier correction as a constraint on a re-asked or retried request, and nothing compares the new reading's scope with the narrowed scope the user already gave. There is still no size or scope check against what one producer run can finish. So the same over-broad reading comes back and the user has to repeat the cut.
prevention: When a request is a re-ask or retry of a job whose reading the user corrected, the reader must be given the prior corrected scope as binding input. The reading is checked against that scope. Any criterion beyond it, such as planning or verifier-stage changes, is rejected or flagged before the reading is shown. A corrected scope is stored with the request family, not only in the earlier job's record. A reading-size check against one producer deadline would catch the wider class.
proposed_request: Make a producer that hits its fixed time deadline keep its worktree edits and write a progress note. Scope is the producer stage only. Make no changes to planning or the verifier stage. Acceptance: (1) when the deadline is reached, the producer's edits stay in the worktree and a progress note is saved; (2) the job is recorded as timed out, not failed; (3) `athena retry` on a timed-out job resumes from the kept work and the note; (4) `athena status` shows timed out separately from failed; (5) tests cover a producer that hits the deadline and then a retry; (6) no files change for planning or verifier timeouts. Use the narrowed scope the user set in job 4zcq as binding.
